roleTitle: Infection Control Nurse & Staff Development Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Infection Control Nurse & Staff Development Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines expertise in infection prevention with a passion for staff education, ensuring the highest standards of patient safety and professional development within our facility. You will play a crucial part in maintaining a healthy and compliant environment for both residents and staff.

In this dual role, you will lead initiatives to prevent and control infections while also developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for our clinical team. Your contributions will directly impact the quality of care and the professional growth of our staff. We offer a competitive hourly rate for this essential position.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in infection prevention and control
Experience in staff education, training, or development
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.

description: An exciting opportunity awaits a dynamic and experienced Marketing Director to join a recently acquired skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This role is pivotal in shaping the facility's presence and growth within the community, offering a chance to make a significant impact during a transformative period.We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance census and community engagement. requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective marketing strategies to drive census growth.
Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills.
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed.
Strong initiative and a results-driven approach to marketing and community relations.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and proven track record.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a reputable medical center in Winslow, AZ, as an Emergency Room Registered Nurse. This role offers a unique opportunity to apply your expertise across various critical care areas, including Labor, Delivery, Recovery, and Postpartum (LDRP), as well as MedSurg. We are seeking passionate and committed RNs ready to make a significant impact in a dynamic environment.

This position comes with an attractive compensation package, including a competitive hourly rate, substantial sign-on bonus, and relocation assistance for eligible candidates. We also offer generous shift differentials for evening, night, and weekend shifts, recognizing your dedication to patient care around the clock. If you are looking for a role where your skills are valued and your commitment is rewarded, this is an excellent opportunity.
requirements: At least 2 years of experience in Labor, Delivery, Recovery, and Postpartum (LDRP)
Minimum of 6 months of MedSurg experience in a hospital setting
NRP certified
Advanced Fetal Monitoring certification
Ability to commit to a two-year term post-probation
salaryOrBonusInfo: The base hourly rate ranges from $43.68 to $62.44, depending on experience. This role includes an attractive sign-on bonus of up to $12,000 and relocation assistance of $6,000, both paid after a 90-day probation period and contingent on a two-year commitment. Additionally, we offer shift differentials: 8% for 3 PM - 11 PM, 16% for 11:01 PM - 7 AM, and a 4% weekend differential from Friday 7 PM to Monday 7 AM.

description:
We are seeking dedicated and experienced Registered Nurses to join our team for night shifts (7 PM - 7 AM). This vital role encompasses Labor, Delivery, Recovery, and Postpartum (LDRP) care, including newborn nursery duties, with a willingness to support our MedSurg unit. This is an exceptional opportunity for an RN looking to make a significant impact in a dynamic healthcare environment.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package, including attractive hourly rates, substantial shift differentials, and a generous sign-on bonus of up to $12,000. Relocation assistance of $6,000 is also available for eligible candidates. Join a supportive team where your skills are valued, and your commitment is rewarded.
requirements: Minimum 2 years of experience in Labor and Delivery (LDRP)
Minimum 6 months of MedSurg experience in a hospital setting
Current NRP certification
Advanced Fetal Monitoring certification
Willingness to commit to a 2-year term
salaryOrBonusInfo: Base pay rate ranges from $43.68 to $62.44 per hour, depending on experience. Additional differentials include 8% for shifts from 3 PM - 11 PM, 16% for shifts from 11:01 PM - 7 AM, and 4% for weekend shifts (Friday 7 PM - Monday 7 AM). A new hire bonus of $12,000 is available for a 2-year commitment, paid after a 90-day probation period. Relocation assistance of $6,000 is available for those moving within 30 miles, also paid after 90 days.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in St. Petersburg, FL. This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, providing an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

This facility is a 55-59 bed center with a current census of 43, located on a main street with abundant shopping nearby and a pleasant neighborhood behind the building. Enjoy the convenience of being just 15 minutes from the beach, with two inviting courtyards on-site, creating a welcoming environment for both staff and residents.

As a COTA, you will play a crucial role in implementing individualized therapy plans, assisting patients in regaining independence, and contributing to a positive and supportive rehabilitation experience. Join a team committed to providing high-quality care in a vibrant community setting.
requirements: Current Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) license in Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited COTA program
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team
Strong communication and documentation skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, based on experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking skilled Commercial/Industrial HVAC Technicians to join a highly reputable company known for its exceptional employee retention and long-term career opportunities. This role involves travel across the vibrant Chicago Metropolitan Area, including parts of Illinois, Wisconsin, and Indiana, providing essential HVAC services to various commercial and industrial facilities. If you are a dedicated professional looking for a stable and rewarding career, this is an excellent opportunity to grow with a company where people stay for decades.

As a Commercial/Industrial HVAC Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC systems, including boilers and chillers. We are looking for individuals who are not just seeking a job, but a long-term career with a company that values its employees. This is an urgent need for three qualified technicians, offering a competitive hourly rate of $30.00 - $40.00.
requirements: Minimum of 5-7 years of overall HVAC experience.
At least 3 years of commercial HVAC experience, including expertise with boilers and chillers.
Proven field experience; not accepting candidates right out of school.
Experience in Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNF) is a plus.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $30.00 - $40.00 based on experience.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Gulfport, MS, as a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) for our specialized Baylor weekend program. This unique opportunity is designed for LPNs who thrive in a consistent weekend schedule, offering 12-hour shifts on both Saturdays and Sundays. We are specifically seeking candidates committed to this weekend schedule, as this is not a PRN position.

While traditional LPN shifts are often 8 hours, this role provides the stability and focus of a dedicated weekend schedule. You will play a crucial role in providing high-quality patient care, ensuring the well-being and comfort of our residents. If you are an LPN looking for a stable weekend position with a consistent schedule, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in the state of Mississippi.
Ability to commit to a consistent Saturday and Sunday, 12-hour shift schedule.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting is preferred.
Strong clinical assessment and patient care skills.
